note: No mass in the ClashStrategic or legacy data; the 1/4/2019 balance update raised the Giant Skeleton's mass to 18 (from 15). https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Giant_Skeleton
The 5/11/2018 balance update decreased the Royal Hogs' mass to 2 (from 4); the legacy snapshot still carries 4. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Royal_Hogs

Sparky is the one unit that deploys unloaded (the game data's LoadFirstHit): a fresh Sparky charges the whole 4 s hit speed before her first shot, then loads 3 s of it while walking so a loaded Sparky fires 1 s after a target is in range (the 3/11/2020 balance note: first attack time interval 1 s), and a stun empties the charge. https://royaleapi.com/blog/secret-stats https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Sparky

Deployment is a horizontal line spanning the Arena (the game data's summonRadius 500 is not that); shifting the central tile by one turns the 3-3 lane split into 4-2, which bounds the spacing between 1 and 3 tiles; 2 puts the outer recruits in front of the Princess Towers. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Royal_Recruits

The Bowler cannot reset the charges of the Prince and Dark Prince because they are immune to knockback; the Prince has an immunity to all forms of knockback, unlike the Battle Ram. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Bowler https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Prince

The Bowler cannot reset the charges of the Prince and Dark Prince because they are immune to knockback; the Prince has an immunity to all forms of knockback, unlike the Battle Ram. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Bowler https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Prince
The Graveyard spawns 13 Skeletons (14 on 12/1/2026, back to 13 on 14/1/2026), one every 0.5 s for 9 s after a 2.2 s delay. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Graveyard
Skeletons rise between 3 tiles from the centre (minimum spawn range, 3/11/2020 and 18/11/2020 changes) and the 4 tile edge of the spell. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Graveyard

After the first three targets the Evolved Electro Dragon's bolt keeps bouncing between the enemies within reach of the last one hit until only one remains, dealing 33% less damage, travelling 80% slower and no longer stunning; a lone target gets nothing to chain onto. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Electro_Dragon/Evolution

Since the 5/5/2025 update the Cannon Cart has no shield; when its hitpoints fall below 50% it becomes a building with a 15 second lifetime (rooted, knockback immune since 6/8/2018), its remaining hitpoints draining over that time. The ClashStrategic record has no skill for the mode switch. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Cannon_Cart

The Doctor's shot deals 92 at level 11 (wiki table and the legacy snapshot agree); the game data dump carries a level 1 projectile damage of 53 that would give 135 and is not corroborated. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Goblinstein
Spawn damage 430 at level 11 (wiki table; the legacy snapshot copied the 537 jump damage). https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Mega_Knight
The 12/2/2018 balance update set the spawn area radius to 2.2 tiles (from 2.5); the legacy snapshot had 3.5. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Mega_Knight

The jump lands with the same 2.2 tile area as the spawn (Liquipedia and wiki hidden stats); the legacy snapshot had 3.5, so a jump hit everything within 3.5 tiles for 537. https://liquipedia.net/clashroyale/Mega_Knight
Bush Goblins deal 256 at level 11 after the 9/4/2025 12% buff (wiki table dmg_11); the legacy snapshot's 355 is unsourced. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Suspicious_Bush
Bush Goblins have 304 hitpoints at level 11 (wiki table hp_11); the legacy snapshot's 476 is unsourced. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Suspicious_Bush

The game data gives the Executioner a 0.9 s hit speed with a 0.4 s load time and a 1.5 s axe flight (pingpongVisualTime), so his first axe leaves 0.5 s after acquiring a target (wiki First Hit Speed) while the card's 2.4 s cycle includes the flight; against that cycle the load time that yields the 0.5 s first hit is 1.9 s (the ClashStrategic 0.4 pairs with the 0.9 s cycle). https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Executioner

Mortar loadTime 3700 in the game data with a 4700 hit speed: the first shell leaves 1 s after a target enters range (wiki First Hit Speed 1 sec); the ClashStrategic 4.0 would make it 0.7 s. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Mortar

The drill itself has no attack: it surfaces with an area blast and then only spawns Goblins (a Goblin every 3 s, two when destroyed); ClashStrategic lists the Goblins' targets on the card, which made the rangeless building hit the tower it was placed on for its 84 spawn damage every 1.2 s. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Goblin_Drill
Resurface damage 84 at level 11 (wiki table spawn_11 and the ClashStrategic damage stat); the legacy snapshot's 66 is stale. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Goblin_Drill
